Bug_Title: Classes extending java.lang.Thread should provide a specific "run" behavior
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the MyThread class which extends Thread but does not override the 'run' method. As a result, when the thread is started in the'showBug' method, nothing happens because the default implementation of 'run' does not execute any task.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case checks if the thread has been terminated after calling the showBug() method that starts the thread. If the thread was terminated without printing 'Hello, World!', then the test case will fail, indicating that the bug has been triggered.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results show that the test passed without any assertion errors. This indicates that the 'Hello, World!' message was not printed, which is expected because the 'run' method is not overridden in the 'MyThread' class. Therefore, the bug was not triggered in this test run.
